ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, November 13, 2017 and to business minors on Monday, November 20, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Informatics Minors on Monday, November 27, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Curric Unassigned or Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Business or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Informatics or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
